    org.springframework.cache.CacheManager
    EgradxAuthAutoConfiguration.egradxCacheManager(EgradxAuthProperties properties)
    In-process Caffeine, not Redis — the same CacheManager SPI PasswordEncoder already demonstrates the pattern for: nothing in EgradxRoleService/EgradxPermissionResolver knows or cares which implementation backs the "egradx-role-authorities" cache name, so a host app can swap in a RedisCacheManager bean later (satisfying this same @ConditionalOnMissingBean) with no code changes anywhere else.
